Empty_Sub: Set up a new mobile authenticator, or import an existing maFile.
Unlock_Sub: Your maFiles are encrypted on disk. Enter the passkey to load them.
Cs2_RestoreSub: Roll accounts back to a backup taken before a sync.
Cs2_NoBackups: No backups yet — they're made when you sync with "back up" on.
Cs2_Sub: Copy this account's CS2 settings onto other accounts on this PC. Local file copy — no login needed.
Cs2_VideoHint: Per-PC (resolution, monitor, GPU). Safe for alts on the same machine; skip across different PCs.
Cs2_Backup: Back up each target's current config first
Cs2_Warn: ⚠ Overwrites the target accounts' CS2 config with this one's. Steam Cloud uploads it on next login. Close Steam for the most reliable result. Backups let you revert.
Cs2_NoSteam: Couldn't find Steam / its userdata folder.
Cs2_SourceHasNone: This account has no CS2 config on this PC to copy from.
Cs2_PickPart: Pick at least one thing to sync.
Cs2_PickTarget: Pick at least one target account.
Deactivate_Warn: ⚠ Removes the Steam Guard mobile authenticator from Steam for the selected accounts, using each one's stored revocation code. This can't be undone here — the accounts are also removed from the app.
Deactivate_ToEmailHint: On: fall back to email codes. Off: turn Steam Guard off entirely.
Devices_SignIn: Sign in to see this account's logged-in devices.
Devices_SessionExpired: Session expired — re-sign in to manage devices.
Devices_ManageHint: Steam only lets you sign devices out on the web. This opens a signed-in, isolated browser window on Steam's Security & Devices page.
Devices_BrowserOpened: Opened a signed-in Steam window — sign out of devices there.
Devices_NoBrowser: No Chrome / Edge / Brave / Chromium browser found to open.
Batch_RemoveSub: Remove {0} account(s) from this app. This deletes their maFiles locally; it does not revoke the authenticator on Steam.
Batch_RemoveWarn: ⚠ Export the maFiles first if you might need them — without them these codes are gone.
Detail_SignInTip: Sign in to Steam to refresh this account's session
Detail_ProfileTip: Open Steam community profile in browser
Detail_UpdateTip: Refresh persona name, avatar and ban status from Steam
Inv_SignIn: Sign in to view this account's inventory.
Detail_TransferTip: Transfer this account's tradable inventory to your trade link
Detail_NotesHint: Add a note for this account…
Offers_SignIn: Sign in to load trade offers.
Offers_LoadFailed: Couldn't load — your session may have expired.
Export_PlaintextWarn: ⚠ Plaintext export leaves your Steam secrets readable by anyone with the file. Only do this if you know what you're doing.
Import_Sub: Select one or more .maFiles exported from SDA or extracted from the Steam mobile app. Encrypted maFiles will prompt for the passkey.
Login_Sub: Refreshes this account's session for trade confirmations.
Login_Note: Your 2FA code is generated automatically from this account. Credentials are sent only to Steam and never stored.
Login_StatusEnterCreds: Enter your Steam username and password.
Login_StatusEmailSent: Steam emailed a code to {0}. Enter it below.
Login_StatusEmailWrong: That code was wrong. Enter the new code Steam emailed to {0}.
Login_StatusSuccess: Signed in — session refreshed. Trade confirmations can now load.
Remove_AppOnlySub: The authenticator stays active on Steam. Export the maFile first — without it your codes are gone.
Remove_ToEmail: Revoke on Steam — back to email codes
Remove_ToEmailSub: Removes the authenticator; Steam Guard falls back to codes sent to your email.
Remove_Full: Revoke on Steam — turn Steam Guard OFF
Remove_FullSub: Removes the authenticator and disables Steam Guard entirely. Trades will be held for days.
Remove_AttemptsWarn: ⚠ Steam allows only a limited number of revocation attempts — a wrong code burns one. Requires a signed-in session.
Passkey_Sub: All account files are encrypted with this passkey; you'll enter it every time the app starts.
Passkey_Warn: ⚠ If you forget the passkey your accounts CANNOT be recovered — the secrets and revocation codes are inside the encrypted files. There is no reset.
Settings_ApiKey: STEAM WEB API KEY (OPTIONAL — FOR EXACT BAN COUNTS)
Notify_NewLoginBody: {0} has a sign-in waiting for approval.
Login_ApprovalWarn: Only approve if this is you signing in right now. If you don't recognize this device or location, deny it.
Qr_NeedSignIn: Sign in to this account first, then scan.
Qr_NoQr: No Steam sign-in QR code found.
Login_StaySignedIn: Stay signed in on that device
Transfer_Sub: Send this account's tradable items to your trade link — one offer per game.
Transfer_SetUrlFirst: ⚠ Set a trade link in Settings first (Trade link field).
Transfer_Warn: ⚠ This sends a real trade offer and confirms it on mobile. Only currently-tradable items are included. Verify on an alt account first.
Transfer_NoTradeUrl: Set a valid trade link in Settings first.
Confirm_StatusSignIn: Sign in to load trade confirmations.
Confirm_StatusSessionExpired: Session expired — Sign in again to refresh it.
Confirm_StatusMissingSecret: This account is missing its identity secret or session.
Confirm_StatusLoadFailed: Couldn't load — your session may have expired. Try Sign in again.
Confirm_StatusRejected: Steam rejected the request — try refreshing.
Confirm_StatusActionFailed: Action failed — your session may have expired.
Remove_StatusDemo: Demo accounts have nothing to revoke — use "remove from this app".
Remove_StatusSessionExpired: Session expired — Sign in again first.
Remove_StatusToEmail: Authenticator removed — the account is back on email codes.
Remove_StatusOff: Authenticator removed — Steam Guard is now OFF for this account.
Import_StatusSkipped: Already imported — skipped {0} to keep existing data.
Import_StatusBatchOkSkipped: Imported {0} — {1} already existed and were skipped.
Import_StatusNeedsPasskeyN: 🔒 {0} encrypted file(s) — enter the passkey to decrypt.
Import_StatusFailedN: Couldn't read {0} of the selected files.
Export_StatusEnterPasskey: Enter a passkey to encrypt, or turn encryption off.
Profile_StatusLoadFailed: Couldn't load profile (private, or Steam offline).
Wizard_StatusNoPhone: This account has no phone. Add one to continue.
Wizard_StatusEnterPhone: Enter a phone number in international format, e.g. +15551234567.
Wizard_StatusPhoneEmailSent: Steam emailed a confirmation link to {0}. Click it, then press Continue.
Wizard_StatusStillWaiting: Still waiting — open the email from Steam and click the confirmation link, then press Continue.
Wizard_StatusPhoneTexted: Steam texted a code to your phone. Enter it to verify the number.
Wizard_StatusEnterPhoneSms: Enter the SMS code Steam texted to verify your phone.
Wizard_StatusAuthPresent: This account already has an authenticator. Remove it first to add this one.
Wizard_StatusEmailSent: Steam emailed a code to {0}. Enter it to continue.
Wizard_StatusEnterSms: Enter the SMS code Steam texted you.
Wizard_RevocationMismatch: Revocation code didn't match — setup cancelled.
Wizard_StatusBadSms: Wrong SMS code — check the text and try again.
Wizard_StatusTimeSync: Couldn't sync codes with Steam. Check your system clock and retry.
Wizard_StatusFinalizeFailed: Finalizing failed. Your revocation code above still works if the authenticator was partially added.
Wizard_Intro: Links this app as your Steam Guard. Steam sends a code to finish — by email if the account has no phone, or by SMS if it does.
Wizard_LoginHint: To finish, Steam sends a verification code — to your email if the account has no phone, or by SMS if it does. No phone number is required.
Wizard_PhoneHint: No phone on this account. Steam emails a confirmation link, then texts a code to verify the number. (One phone can be used on several accounts; you'll enter two SMS codes total — one for the phone, one for the authenticator.)
Wizard_RevocationWarn: ⚠ Write this revocation code down NOW. It is the ONLY way to remove the authenticator if you lose access to it.
Wizard_RevocationHint: You'll re-enter this code on the next screen to confirm you saved it.
Finalize_Intro: Enter the code Steam sent you, and re-enter your revocation code to confirm you saved it.
Finalize_CodePh: code Steam emailed or texted you
EmailCode_Intro: Steam emailed a verification code. Enter it to continue.
